description.zh:
全球加速实例的描述信息。  

长度为 2-256个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，但不能以`http://` 或`https://`开头。
description.en:
The description of the GA instance.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It must start with a letter but cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
The ID of the GA instance.

description.zh:
全球加速实例的名称。  

长度为 2-128个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字，点号（.），下划线（_）和短横线（-）。但不能以`http://` 或`https://`开头。
description.en:
The name of the GA instance.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
全球加速实例所在的地域。 

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the GA instance.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

title.zh: 修改全球加速实例属性

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc modify-global-acceleration-instance-attributes --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --global-acceleration-instance-id ga-14fdsf30000 --name GA-1 --description My_GA --region cn-hangzhou
